name: horos
description: Classify a repository's token sinks with evidence and emit the reading boundary agents respect.

interface.shortDescription: Classify a repository's token sinks with evidence and emit the reading boundary agents respect.
interface.longDescription: Horos walks a repository, classifies generated files, vendored trees, lockfiles, minified bundles, and single-line blobs with the evidence that earned each exclusion, writes a deterministic boundary, and verifies it against tree drift. It also emits skeleton maps for Python, TypeScript, Go, C++, Solidity, and Markdown. The boundary is advisory, fail-open, and disabled during every security review. A content-addressed object store is bound by the digest of each file's own bytes, and a Markdown map is its headings and fenced code blocks.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use horos to scan this repository and emit the reading boundary.
